possessor-after.title: Put the owner after the thing
possessor-after.bodyMarkdown:
In a simple possessive noun phrase, the possessor comes after the thing:

- **machin mwen** — my car
- **kaye ou** — your notebook
- **fanmi li** — his/her family

The same personal forms from Module 3 now show ownership.

with-definite.title: machin mwen an
with-definite.bodyMarkdown:
When the phrase is definite, the definite marker still comes at the end:

**machin mwen an** — my car / the car that is mine

The pattern is: **thing + possessor + definite marker**.

se-pou.title: Sa se pou mwen
se-pou.bodyMarkdown:
You can also express ownership with **se pou**:

- **Sa se pou mwen.** — This/that is mine / for me.
- **Liv la se pou li.** — The book is his/hers.

This pattern is useful when identifying who an object belongs to.
